invariants.requirement: Every file operation requires an authenticated principal and is authorized per resource; a file the caller may not access is indistinguishable from one that does not exist.
No internal storage detail — bucket, storage key, checksum, owner identifier — appears in any public response.
Content type and size are validated server-side; empty, oversized and disallowed content is refused through the canonical error envelope, and the declared type never overrides the detected one.
Binary content is written to the object store and its metadata to the relational store; the stored object is never publicly readable.
Download is granted through a short-lived signed URL that is never cacheable, issued only to an authorized principal, and never as a durable public path.
Metadata listing returns only files owned by the requester, in a stable paginated order, excluding deleted entries.
Deletion removes both the object and its metadata, invalidates previously issued download URLs, is idempotent and requires its own permission.
Quarantine blocks download until an explicit restore and requires a permission distinct from ownership.
Maintenance runs under an exclusive lock that refuses concurrent runs, and purges a deleted record only once its object is confirmed absent.
The per-owner active-file quota holds under concurrent uploads and cannot be exceeded by racing requests.
File content, local device paths and raw file names never reach logs, telemetry or shared client state.

The client validates the declared file shape and type before sending, and uploads only through the authenticated client with state-changing requests protected against cross-origin submission where the platform exposes one.
Listing is rendered from server-provided data with explicit pagination, is never cached across sessions, and maps failures to distinct, non-revealing states.
Download uses only a server-issued URL whose scheme is validated before use; no path is constructed client-side and no reference is left behind in the document.
Deletion is a protected state-changing operation, refused without a valid origin and CSRF proof, and never issued from an unvalidated identifier.
Quarantine and restore are protected state-changing operations carrying the caller's authorization, refused without a valid origin and CSRF proof.
